meta.name: vercel-cli
meta.description: Deploy apps to Vercel. Use when asked to deploy, ship, or publish a web application, or manage Vercel projects, domains, and environment variables.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把网页应用发布到 Vercel，管理域名和环境变量
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你经常要把网站部署到 Vercel 并管理其设置
copy.tagline_en: Deploy web apps to Vercel and manage domains and env vars
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly deploy websites to Vercel and manage their settings.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会使用 Vercel 命令行把 Web 应用部署到 Vercel,并能管理项目、域名和环境变量。部署前会先本地构建、确认部署状态和线上地址可访问,检查通过后才把地址给你。
howto.when: 当你要求部署、发布一个 Web 应用,或让你管理 Vercel 项目、域名、环境变量时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个项目部署到 Vercel 生产环境
say.note: Claude 会先本地构建再部署,成功后给你线上地址。

say.text: 列出我最近的 Vercel 部署记录
say.note: Claude 会运行 vercel ls 列出近期部署。

say.text: 把域名 example.com 加到当前 Vercel 项目
say.note: Claude 会执行 vercel domains add。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude uses the Vercel CLI to deploy web apps to Vercel, manage projects, domains, and env vars. Before sharing the URL, it verifies the build, deployment status, and live response.
howto.when_en: Triggered when asked to deploy, ship, or publish a web application, or manage Vercel projects, domains, and environment variables.

say_en.text: Deploy this project to Vercel production
say_en.note: Claude builds locally, deploys, and gives you the live URL.
Claude runs vercel ls to show recent deployments.

say_en.text: Add domain example.com to the current Vercel project
